mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE > 5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening demand, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 5% for two consecutive months signals strengthening labor demand and earnings growth, which increases S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS > 5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals strengthening demand, which increases S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained GDPC1 increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing and supply activity, which increases S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained INDPRO increases (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE > 5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).
